summary: TriCo Bancshares filed an 8-K reporting a definitive merger agreement with First Hawaiian, Inc. Under the terms, each TriCo share will be converted into 2.095 FHI shares (stock consideration). The merger was unanimously approved by both boards. The structure involves a two-step merger followed by a bank-level merger. No premium, price per share, or deal value is stated. No break fee or expected close date is disclosed. Watch for regulatory approvals and shareholder votes; the fixed exchange ratio subjects TriCo holders to FHI stock price risk until closing.
